title: Great driver and great...
text: Great driver and great tour of Barcelona.  Beautiful city and lots to see. The traffic in the afternoon was horrible but no fault of the company.
author: Robert_M

title: Be sure to ask for Damion.
text: Damion was amazing. His love of the area and history made the tour amazing. He also took us to a local tapa place and helped us order the best tapas to sample. I would not only book this tour again but also book Damion. We had a friend join us and helped was helpful in picking up our lost friend but making sure he got back to his destination following our tour. That to us went beyond kind and rewarding.
author: Teresa_L

title: Great private highlights tour
text: We had a short time in Barcelona and wanted to see the major sites. We had 10hours from getting off cruise shiptoneeding tobe at airport. We had suitcases and Carry-on bags for our family of 4. We were picked up by Jaimie at Port and he was wonderful and showed us many great places and suggested a fabulous restaurant and then dropped us off at the airport.  Lovely Mercedes suv limo. We'll worth the money, our family felt like we got to see so much and Damian was a superstar
author: Jennifer_F

title: Barcelona in style, seven hours of pure freedom, and a van that moved like a personal runway.
text:
Impeccable service, start to finish.
Our day in Barcelona was completely elevated thanks to BCN Luxury Limousines. The private van was spotless, cool, and spacious—perfect for our multigenerational group with kids and an elder. Our driver was kind, prompt, and fully at our disposal for the full 7 hours, making sightseeing, shopping, and lunch at Paco Meralgo absolutely seamless. The whole experience felt luxe, relaxed, and personalized. Highly recommend to anyone who wants to move through Barcelona like a local—but better.
author: Ali_Wong1

title: Excellent tour!...
text: Excellent tour! Alessandro was amazing! He is very friendly, knowledgeable and accommodating.  In addition to seeing numerous landmarks and important sites in Barcelona, we learned an incredible amount about the local culture and history.  We wanted to grab a bite to eat for the kids and Alessandro was able to help us secure a wonderful lunch venue.  Definitively recommend!
author: Kevin_J

title: Gaudi Guide Extraordinaire - Miriam
text: I had booked this tour as a “friends favor” to essentially be a Day of Gaudi.  This included Sagrada Familia, Park Gueill, La Pedrerà and finally in the Gaudi Museum. My/our friend is an architect in the States who was moved to total émotion based on the extraordinairy job our Tour Guide, Miriam, did in matching architectural techno talk with my friend. Might I say to his surprise. Miriam was prepared for every zig and zag. She even went beyond the call of duty to assist my wife and I in planning a beautiful trip to Costa Brava. Miriam and David, our driver, were an exceptional team.
author: Lynn W

title: Highly recommend, very knowledgeable and easy to under!
text: Marco was a fabulous tour guide. He has lived in Barcelona all his life and is an expert on the area and the history! His English is excellent so very easy to understand. Also very flexible if you need to change or modify your plans. We will definitely be using his services again on our next trip to Barcelona!!
author: lorig716

title: Wonderful Barcelona
text: We had a great time in Barcelona on this tour.  It was the perfect way to see everything without crowding on and off a bus.  I’m just one day we got a real flavor of the city.
author: Jennifer_H

title: Excellent
text: Service was perfect, we arrived a little earlier and the driver was waiting for us already. The car was impecable and the driver knowlegable. ( very good english)
author: Marlene M

title: Best Way To Get Around Barcelona
text:
We reserved with Marco Xavier for a day tour in Barcelona after we debarked our cruise ship.  It was a perfect day of city highlights but the best part was a private tour and tasting at Pares Balta.  One of the best ever for the 4 of us.
Marco was prompt to respond to my many emails from the beginning.  We also arranged our hotel to Barcelona airport with BCN.
Highly recommend and will use again when we return to Barcelona
author: Karen L
